These steps are taken by the government to increase demand. Pro-cyclical fiscal policy strengthens the business cycle by expanding during good times and contracting during recessions. Pursuing pro-cyclical fiscal policy is generally considered dangerous, as it may reduce investment in real and human capital, hinder growth and harm the poor can causes harm.
